source: HTTP replay through production Binance adapter, real Auth/session and PostgreSQL
draw: Inconclusive until the runner proves a paint for the selected data.

agentChoices.ports: Agent selected loopback ports 5195, 3025 and 3026 to isolate the benchmark from dev and E2E servers.
agentChoices.fixture: Agent selected a fixed integer progression, seed 20261121, epoch 1735689600000 and 519 candles per key. These values are synthetic inputs, not production requirements.
agentChoices.resourceInterval: Agent selected a 1000 ms resource interval and 20 ms event-loop histogram resolution for diagnostics. No acceptance threshold uses these values.
agentChoices.weight: Synthetic version 1 uses weight 2 for each replay endpoint. This is not a claim about current Binance quota.
agentChoices.instrumentation: A User Timing mark follows all three setData calls. Its detail records the applied series. Marks are cleared after observation. A mark does not prove a canvas paint. Observer serialization and reconciliation add overhead to this cohort.
agentChoices.cacheHitPreparation: The 1000 ms guard is the approved 6000 ms think time minus the 5000 ms TTL. A near-expiry prime waits 6000 ms before priming again. The extra wait occurs before timing starts.
agentChoices.authPreparation: Setup retries once after Auth returns 429. The retry uses X-Retry-After from the real response. Auth uses the production rate-limit configuration. A 429 during the measured action remains an error.
agentChoices.uiObservation: Parsed Market Data responses record the server request ID. Each sample records request starts and timeOrigin. The runner requests a screenshot after an invalid sample.
agentChoices.httpClock: Native k6 HTTP timings use UnixNano wall-clock differences. Monotonic timing is not verified. The protocol decision is pending.
